description: This file defines the PayGradeDao class which interacts with the database to perform CRUD operations related to PayGrade, PayGradeCurrency, and related entities within the Human Resource Management system. It includes methods for retrieving, saving, deleting pay grades and currencies, as well as fetching associated data with filtering and pagination support.

classes.name: PayGradeDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for interacting with PayGrade-related database entities and performing complex queries involving pay grades, currencies, and filtering with pagination.

methods.name: getPayGradeById
methods.description: Retrieves a PayGrade entity by its ID.

methods.name: getExistingPayGradeIds
methods.description: Returns a list of existing pay grade IDs from a given list of IDs.

methods.name: getPayGradeList
methods.description: Fetches a list of PayGrade entities based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getPayGradesPaginator
methods.description: Private method that sets up pagination for pay grade queries based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getCurrencyListByPayGradeId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of PayGradeCurrency entities associated with a specific pay grade.

methods.name: getPayGradeCurrencyPaginator
methods.description: Creates a paginator for PayGradeCurrency entities based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getPayGradeCurrencyList
methods.description: Fetches a list of PayGradeCurrency entities based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getPayGradeCurrencyListCount
methods.description: Returns the count of PayGradeCurrency entries matching filter params.

methods.name: getCurrencyByCurrencyIdAndPayGradeId
methods.description: Fetches a PayGradeCurrency entity for a specific currency ID and pay grade ID.

methods.name: getPayPeriods
methods.description: Retrieves all available pay periods.

methods.name: getCurrencies
methods.description: Retrieves all available currencies.

methods.name: getCurrencyById
methods.description: Finds a CurrencyType entity by its ID.

methods.name: getExistingCurrencyIdsForPayGradeId
methods.description: Returns currency IDs that exist for a specific pay grade among a list of IDs.

methods.name: getPayGradesCount
methods.description: Returns the total count of pay grades matching the provided filter.

methods.name: savePayGrade
methods.description: Saves or updates a PayGrade entity.

methods.name: savePayGradeCurrency
methods.description: Saves or updates a PayGradeCurrency entity.

methods.name: deletePayGrades
methods.description: Deletes multiple pay grades based on provided IDs.

methods.name: deletePayGradeCurrency
methods.description: Deletes currency associations for a pay grade based on currency IDs.

methods.name: getAllowedPayCurrencies
methods.description: Retrieves pay currencies that are allowed for a specific pay grade filter.

methods.name: getAllowedPayCurrenciesCount
methods.description: Counts the allowed pay currencies based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getAllowedPayCurrenciesPaginator
methods.description: Provides a paginator for allowed pay currencies based on filter parameters.
